name: Alamin SN Injection 200ml
introduction:
Introduction About ALAMIN SN INJECTION

Alamin SN Injection is used in hypermetabolic states requiring protein supplementation and in pregnancy complications due to nutritional deficiency. It contains L-Histidine, L-Isoleucine, L-Leucine, L-Lysine, L-Methionine, L-Phenylalanine, L-Threonine, L-Tryptophan, L-Valine, and Xylitol which belongs to the group of medicines called Amino acids, which help in the growth, repair of body tissues, breakdown of food, and regulation of many other body functions.

During pregnancy, amino acids serve as important precursors for fetal development and growth and the development of the metabolic cyclic pathways between the placenta and foetus. It is also essential for the biosynthesis of proteins, nucleotides, and neurotransmitters.

Before using Alamin SN Injection, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing disease conditions or if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding. Consult your doctor if you experience any side effects after using Alamin SN Injection.

name: Nephrosteril Infusion 250ml
introduction:
Introduction About NEPHROSTERIL INFUSION

NEPHROSTERIL INFUSION contains Amino acid which are naturally occurring physiological compounds. It is used for management of protein depletion in patients requiring parenteral nutrition when oral or enteral nutrition is not possible, insufficient, or not recommended. NEPHROSTERIL INFUSION can be used to manage negative nitrogen balance in patients.

NEPHROSTERIL INFUSION can also be used to manage hepatic encephalopathy in patients with liver scarring or inflammation.

Your doctor might monitor your fluid an electrolyte status and various other functions throughout your management.

NEPHROSTERIL INFUSION is not recommended for use in patients with amino acid metabolism problems since birth, pulmonary edema, or excess acid in blood due to low cardiac output. Before receiving NEPHROSTERIL INFUSION, inform your doctor if you have diabetes, kidney, heart, or liver disease.

NEPHROSTERIL INFUSION should be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if considered clearly necessary. NEPHROSTERIL INFUSION is not recommended for use in children and should be used with caution in elderly patients, therefore consult your doctor before receiving it.

The most common side effects of receiving NEPHROSTERIL INFUSION are generalized flushing, fever, nausea, and local injection site reactions. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: RINGER LACTATE Infusion 500ml
introduction:
Introduction About RINGER LACTATE INFUSION

Ringer Lactate Infusion 500ml is a sterile intravenous (IV) solution formulated to support fluid and electrolyte balance in patients who are unable to maintain hydration orally. Its composition closely mimics the natural plasma electrolyte levels with sodium, potassium, calcium, chloride, and lactate, making it highly suitable for clinical fluid replacement under medical supervision. This infusion is commonly used in hospital settings for patients recovering from surgery, fluid loss, or conditions where intravenous hydration is required.  

Ringer Lactate Infusion 500ml is ideal for patients who need restoration of circulatory volume and electrolyte stability, such as those with moderate fluid depletion, post-surgical recovery, or certain clinical conditions where fluid support is essential. The infusion is administered intravenously by healthcare professionals at a rate and dosage determined by the patient’s hydration needs, body weight, and medical condition. Continuous monitoring of vital signs, urine output, and electrolyte levels ensures safe and effective use.

This infusion should be used cautiously in patients with kidney, heart, liver, or lung conditions, as excess fluid may lead to swelling, fluid overload, or electrolyte imbalances. It is not recommended for individuals with hyperkalaemia, hypercalcemia, or severe fluid retention. Pregnant and breastfeeding women should only receive Ringer Lactate under medical supervision, and elderly patients or children require careful dose adjustments and monitoring.

Ringer Lactate Infusion 500ml may cause mild swelling, redness at the injection site, or changes in electrolyte levels in some patients. Rarely, allergic reactions such as rash, itching, or breathing difficulty may occur. Prompt medical attention is required if any unusual symptoms appear during the infusion.

How RINGER LACTATE INFUSION Works
Ringer Lactate Infusion Mechanism of Action

Ringer Lactate Infusion 500ml works by supplying a balanced mixture of electrolytes and fluids that closely resemble the natural composition of blood plasma. When administered intravenously, it helps restore and maintain fluid balance in the body while supporting normal cellular and organ function.

Sodium and Chloride help regulate water distribution and maintain osmotic balance.
Potassium supports muscle contractions and nerve function.
Calcium assists in blood clotting and cardiac function.
Lactate contributes to maintaining the body’s acid-base equilibrium.

This combined action helps stabilize circulation and support hydration in clinical settings under medical supervision.

Role of Lactate in Ringer Lactate Infusion 

Lactate in Ringer Lactate Infusion plays an important role in supporting acid-base balance within the body. After administration, lactate is metabolized in the liver into bicarbonate, which helps buffer excess acid in the blood and maintain a stable pH. This makes Ringer Lactate especially useful in situations where balanced fluid and electrolyte support is needed, as it reduces the risk of acid-base disturbances during medical care.

introduction:
Introduction About D-5 (INVEN) INJECTION

D-5 (INVEN) INJECTIONcontains Dextrose which belongs to the group of medicines called Fluids and Electrolytes. It is used in adults and in children as a fluid replacement therapy to provide energy and to prevent fluid loss (dehydration) from the body. It acts as a source of calories (for energy) and water (for hydration) for our body. D-5 (INVEN) INJECTION can also be used as a diluent (liquid used for mixing) for another medications (such as heart medicines, stomach medicines, brain medicines) before administration. D-5 (INVEN) INJECTION will be administered to you only by your doctor or a nurse as a slow intravenous infusion (i.e., through veins).

Before D-5 (INVEN) INJECTION is given to you, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, bleeding in the brain or spine, sugar intolerance, damaged veins, or a very low urine output before receiving the medicine. During management with D-5 (INVEN) INJECTION your doctor will constantly monitor your blood sugar and electrolyte levels as a precaution.

D-5 (INVEN) INJECTION should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effect of receiving D-5 (INVEN) INJECTION is pain, irritation and swelling at the injection site. Place an ice pack on the injected site to ease the irritation. If the symptom did not improve, inform your doctor.

Introduction About METHICO 500MCG INJECTION

METHICO 500MCG INJECTION contains Methylcobalamin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamins. METHICO 500MCG INJECTION is used to manage diabetic neuropathy (nerve damage caused by diabetes), peripheral neuropathy (peripheral nerve damage that affects hands, feet, and arms), and megaloblastic anaemia (blood disorder) caused by vitamin B12 deficiency in affected individuals.

METHICO 500MCG INJECTION is also used to manage sciatica pain (leg pain), back pain, and general weakness in affected individuals.

METHICO 500MCG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to mecobalamin and/or other B12-containing medicines.

Before receiving METHICO 500MCG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have Leber's disease (an inherited form of vision loss) and/or are suffering from low potassium levels (with associated signs such as muscle twitches/cramps, low blood pressure), optic nerve disease (swelling and nerve damage to the eyes), and kidney and/or liver problems.

METHICO 500MCG INJECTION is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 6 months to 18 years) and in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving METHICO 500MCG INJECTION are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loss of appetite, skin rash, and/or hot flushes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Introduction About METHICO 1500MCG INJECTION

METHICO 1500MCG INJECTION contains Methylcobalamin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Vitamins. METHICO 1500MCG INJECTION is used to manage diabetic neuropathy (nerve damage caused by diabetes), peripheral neuropathy (peripheral nerve damage that affects hands, feet, and arms), and megaloblastic anaemia (blood disorder) caused by vitamin B12 deficiency in affected individuals.

METHICO 1500MCG INJECTION is also used to manage sciatica pain (leg pain), back pain, and general weakness in affected individuals.

METHICO 1500MCG INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to mecobalamin and/or other B12-containing medicines.

Before receiving METHICO 1500MCG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have Leber's disease (an inherited form of vision loss) and/or are suffering from low potassium levels (with associated signs such as muscle twitches/cramps, low blood pressure), optic nerve disease (swelling and nerve damage to the eyes), and kidney and/or liver problems.

METHICO 1500MCG INJECTION is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in breastfeeding women. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 6 months to 18 years) and in elderly patients (aged above 65 years) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of receiving METHICO 1500MCG INJECTION are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, loss of appetite, skin rash, and/or hot flushes. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

How METHICO 1500MCG INJECTION Works

METHICO 1500MCG INJECTION works by aiding in the synthesis of myelin (a lipid-rich material that covers nerve fibers), which helps in protecting the nerve fibers and thereby providing relief from diabetic and peripheral neuropathy, sciatica pain, and back pain in affected individuals. It also promotes nucleic acid synthesis in the bone marrow, which helps in the maturation and division of erythroblasts, thus managing poor production of red blood cells and thereby improving megaloblastic anaemia in affected individuals.
